name: Community connectors (n8n import)
description: Nine integration presets (Slack, Telegram, Discord, Notion, GitHub, Jira, Trello, Asana, Mattermost) converted from n8n community nodes. They give Mockarty pre-filled CONNECTIONS to those services — they do not run n8n workflows.

connectors.name: Asana
connectors.description: Consume Asana REST API Category: Productivity.

connectors.name: Discord
connectors.description: Sends data to Discord Category: Communication, HITL.

connectors.name: Jira Software
connectors.description: Consume Jira Software API Category: Development, Productivity.

connectors.name: Mattermost
connectors.description: Sends data to Mattermost Category: Communication.

connectors.name: Slack
connectors.description: Consume Slack API Category: Communication, HITL.

connectors.name: Telegram
connectors.description: Sends data to Telegram Category: Communication, HITL.

connectors.name: Trello
connectors.description: Create, change and delete boards and cards Category: Productivity.

event_types.title: Community preset used
event_types.description: Raised the first time a namespace configures one of these presets, so an operator can see which integrations a team actually adopted.

settings_schema.description: Credentials for the presets you actually use. Each field holds a REFERENCE to an entry in your secret store — the token itself is never stored here.

slack_token.title: Slack bot token
slack_token.description: Reference to the secret holding the Slack bot token.

telegram_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_token.description: Reference to the secret holding the Telegram bot token.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Reference to the secret holding a GitHub personal access token.

jira_token.title: Jira API token
jira_token.description: Reference to the secret holding the Jira API token.

notion_token.title: Notion integration token
notion_token.description: Reference to the secret holding the Notion integration token.

default_connection.title: Default connection
default_connection.description: An existing connection to reuse when a preset does not name its own.
